plan.title: Load repository-local packs and bind their definitions to evidence

criteria.description: Load a local manifest with namespaced checks and surfaces and restrictive inherited prerequisites.
Reject collisions, unsupported schemas, invalid requirements and traversal or symlink paths.
Changing pack definitions or bundled files invalidates passing evidence.

limitations: Repository-local packs only; no download, installation, package registry or tool-version probing.
Pack surfaces are declarations for the next baseline task; init activation remains explicit config editing.
Path checks reject symlinks but do not sandbox trusted shell commands or hostile concurrent filesystem changes.
